chapters.title: Bugs that only exist in time
chapters.summary: The one plum register. The stacked recording chips flatten into a frame ribbon and the scrubber runs backwards: 'Some bugs only exist in time.' Replay QA's own Projects page: a 67 ms commit (Open; Discovered · Sep 23 · 5:56 PM · PR preview) crosses four 16.7 ms slots while the music stops for four beats; no click, a background refresh re-rendered the whole list; 27 fiber squares, 25 hollow; 'A screenshot can't see that. A Replay recording can.' on a match cut to the real Root Cause. Then the live-sync page (Fixed; Discovered · Sep 4 · 2:16 AM · Local): the user does nothing, a counter races to 258 while checkpoint −1 never moves, the hats stop dead, the scrubber rewinds. In the corner, unnarrated, a developer hands a ▶ recording to a critic: not yet, then good. The page pulls back into a tile captioned 'Replay QA's own Projects page'.
